title: Why the Same Coin Shows Different Prices
summary: Crypto trades on many venues at once, each with its own buyers and sellers, so the exact price can differ slightly from place to place at any instant.
blocks: Crypto trades on many venues at once, each with its own buyers and sellers, so the exact price can differ slightly from place to place at any instant.
Data providers also aggregate and average these venues differently, and updates arrive at slightly different times — so two apps can show marginally different numbers.
For major coins the differences are usually small. Larger gaps tend to appear in thinly traded coins where each venue is more isolated.
